credibility.line: Missed FY26 revenue growth guidance, but exceeded working capital reduction targets and expanded total order book.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management reiterated 15% FY26 revenue growth, but reported full-year growth reached only 11.8%.
Management claimed working capital ratio improved to 4.1% in Q4 FY26, beating the 10% target.
Management claimed Q1 FY27 revenue grew 7% YoY, matching reported growth of 6.7% to ₹67,942 crore.
Annual operating cash flow improved to ₹16,741 crore in FY26 from ₹9,151 crore in FY25.

bull: Order book expanded 27% YoY to ₹7.79 trillion as of June 2026.
FY26 operating cash flow rebounded 83% YoY to ₹16,741 crore.
Working capital to revenue ratio improved sharply to 4.1% by March 2026.
bear: FY26 full year revenue growth of 11.8% fell short of the 15% guidance.
Full year EBITDA margin dropped from 17.0% in FY21 to 13.0% in FY26.
Q1 FY27 revenue growth decelerated to 6.7% YoY at ₹67,942 crore.
watch: FY27 full-year revenue growth achieving the 10%-12% targeted band.
PPM portfolio margins stabilizing at the guided 7.8% level in FY27.
